description_for_human: Search the AYA index of 3000+ companies rated for AI readability (AIO score 0-100).
description_for_model: AYA is a public index of 3000+ organizations rated for AI readability. Use /api/aya/llm/{domain} for an ultra-simple 5-field summary (name, what_it_does, for_who, category, location) — best for quick lookups. Use /api/aya/search?q=... to find companies by name, sector, or country. Use /api/aya/entity/{domain} for full details with ASR data. Use /api/aya/stats for index-wide context. No authentication required.
